content_blocks.heading: How should you evaluate an Indus Valley offer?
content_blocks.body: Check the exact Indus Valley product on the official site, confirm ingredients, size and usage directions, then review the final cart total including shipping. Test any promo code in checkout and read current shipping/return terms before paying.

items.title: Hair/skin sensitivity: verify ingredients
items.body: Check the full ingredient list and usage directions on the exact product page. If you have allergies, sensitivity, or an active condition, patch-test where appropriate and seek professional advice.

items.title: Regimen/cart bundles: compare actual need
items.body: Bundle discounts can be useful only if you need every product. Compare the bundle price against buying the specific product you want and check expiry/shelf-life practicality.

items.title: Offer checking: confirm in cart
items.body: Apply any code in the official checkout and confirm the final payable amount. Do not count a discount or free-shipping claim until the cart reflects it.
